_comment: Spec 345: where AIDE_INSTALL_CMD/installCmd is read from, as the table
Unlike worktree-links-precedence.json, `.aide/config` WINS here when both
set a value — the reverse order, because an install/test command can
legitimately differ per machine while a worktree link cannot.
`value` is what both sides must resolve to. `source` is what both sides
report — `.aide/config` or `project.yaml`. null means: the key is not
written in that file at all.
